title: Page
description: Fiori page container: header bar, scrolling content and a floating or fixed footer bar, with responsive padding and background designs (ui5-page).

usage.summary: Hold one application screen with a header bar, scrolling content and optional floating or fixed footer.
useWhen: Complete a task on one screen while keeping its header and footer separate from the scrolling content.
Provide a page container without an expandable, structured header.
Give the parent a fixed height; use noScrolling when a child owns scrolling and fixedFooter when the footer must dock below content.

avoidWhen.when: Keep filters or structured context in a header that collapses while the page content scrolls.
Organize one object’s details with section navigation and an object header.
Start from a complete guided creation page with 3–8 steps, validation and review.
